when demotion was awarded as a punishment in similar cases. Initially,
when the inquiry was set up, every member was of the view of
downgrading his current rank. But one member shared his/her view about
his termination. Over the discussions, it was found that every member

questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Tolerance for physical density is often higher in traditional Indian collective culture compared to Western individualistic societies.
Statement II: High physical density in India completely eliminates all negative psychological consequences of crowding across all settings.

In light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Validates both statements as accurate NCERT facts.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid NCERT facts erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement II.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Statement I is correct because collective cultural socialization in India fosters greater acceptance of close interpersonal physical proximity in festivals, joint families, and markets. Statement II is incorrect because excessive density still produces adverse psychological stress, sensory overload, and task impairment when spatial resources are severely compromised.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (A) is correct.
